name: Cagayan River White Water Rafting
description: Exhilarating white water rafting adventure on Class II-III rapids. Multiple courses available from beginner to extreme levels. Year-round rafting capital of the Philippines with 14-27 rapids depending on course chosen.

name: Mapawa Nature Park
description: 2500-hectare eco-tourism destination offering canyoneering river trek waterfall rappelling cliff jumping ziplines and horseback riding. Features centuries-old trees waterfalls and pristine forest environment.

name: Divisoria Night Market
description: Vibrant weekend street market Friday and Saturday nights with food stalls street vendors live music and ukay-ukay shopping. Famous for grilled seafood chicken inasal pork barbecue and lechon at budget-friendly prices.

name: Centrio Mall
description: Modern upscale Ayala mall with open-air central plaza department stores international restaurant chains cinemas and children's play areas. Connected to Seda Centrio hotel.

name: Limketkai Mall
description: Landmark shopping center at the heart of CDO commercial area. Features supermarket local product shops like Pastel and chicharon restaurants and large multi-function hall.

name: Saint Augustine Metropolitan Cathedral
description: Historic cathedral with long history dating back to Spanish colonial era. Rebuilt in 1950s after WWII destruction. Features open walls colorful stained glass and interesting architectural elements.

name: Gaston Park
description: Historic urban park also known as Golden Friendship Park. Features expansive green spaces central fountain with evening lights and monuments commemorating important city history including 1900 battle with Americans.

name: Museum of Three Cultures
description: Small but well-curated museum displaying artifacts and photographs of regional history covering Mindanao Cagayan de Oro and Marawi heritage. Three exhibition halls featuring prehistory and cultural heritage.

name: Xavier Museum
description: Museum showcasing rich religious and colonial history of the region. Features art historical artifacts and cultural exhibitions related to CDO development.

name: Divine Mercy Shrine
description: Sacred pilgrimage site featuring impressive Divine Mercy statue and peaceful grounds. Offers panoramic 180-degree city views perfect for sunset visits. Serene atmosphere for reflection.

name: Seven Seas Waterpark Resort
description: Pirate-themed waterpark with longest slide in Mindanao biggest dual wave pool in Philippines Shipwreck Island Treasure Island and Pirate Lookout Tower. Family-friendly attractions.

name: Gardens of Malasag Eco-Tourism Village
description: Eco-tourism destination showcasing indigenous cultures of Mindanao. Features traditional houses cultural performances scenic gardens and educational exhibits about tribal heritage.

name: City Museum of Cagayan de Oro
description: Housed in historic 1922 water tower bombed during WWII. Unique museum structure featuring city history and development. Compact but interesting collection.

name: SM City CDO Downtown Premier
description: Popular shopping destination known for significant discounts during sales. Multiple stores boutiques restaurants and entertainment options. Favorite among bargain hunters.

name: Kagay-an Zipzone
description: Thrilling zipline experience offering scenic views and adrenaline rush. Part of adventure attractions in nearby Bukidnon accessible from CDO.

name: Migtuksok Falls
description: Scenic waterfall accessible near Mapawa area. Natural swimming area with clear waters surrounded by lush vegetation. Less crowded than major attractions.

name: Del Monte Pineapple Plantation
description: Vast 5000-hectare pineapple plantation producing fruit exported to Japan and USA. Features giant pineapple statue American-style farm houses and processing plant tour.

name: Camiguin Island Day Trip
description: Island born of fire featuring white sand beaches waterfalls lush jungles volcanic landscapes and hot springs. Full day trip from CDO with peaceful atmosphere.

name: Hugo Sky Lounge
description: Rooftop bar and restaurant offering panoramic city views. Perfect for sunset dining romantic dinners and evening drinks with twilight sky ambiance.

name: Seda Centrio Hotel
description: Premier 4-star hotel with 147 newly renovated rooms. Directly connected to Centrio Mall. Features restaurant bar executive lounge outdoor pools fitness center and excellent breakfast buffet. Walking distance to major attractions.

name: Red Planet Cagayan de Oro
description: Budget-friendly hotel chain offering clean comfortable rooms. Good location near malls and attractions. No-frills but reliable accommodation.

name: Limketkai Luxe Hotel
description: Connected to Limketkai Mall for ultimate shopping convenience. Comfortable rooms with modern amenities. Perfect for shoppers and business travelers.

name: 1A Express Hotel
description: Clean affordable accommodation in city center. Basic amenities with friendly service. Walking distance to Plaza Divisoria and downtown attractions.

name: Chali Resort and Conference Center
description: Resort-style accommodation with conference facilities. Peaceful setting outside city center. Features pools gardens and event spaces.

name: Cucina Higala
description: Authentic Filipino flavors with modern presentation. Known for traditional dishes crafted with love. Popular among locals and tourists.

name: Circa 1850
description: Heritage restaurant where tradition meets innovation. Serves authentic Filipino cuisine in elegant colonial-inspired setting. Signature dishes showcase regional flavors.

name: Tadakuma Japanese Restaurant
description: Authentic Japanese cuisine including sushi ramen and Japanese curry. Fresh ingredients and traditional preparation. Popular among Japanese food enthusiasts.

name: Boy Zugba
description: Authentic Filipino flavors in vibrant casual setting. Known for grilled dishes and local specialties. Great value for traditional cuisine.

name: TGIF Cagayan de Oro
description: American casual dining chain. Features burgers ribs salads and signature drinks. Family-friendly atmosphere with consistent quality.

name: Pepper Lunch
description: Interactive teppan dining where food sizzles on hot iron plates. Japanese-style beef rice and noodles. Quick casual dining experience.

name: Sentro 1850
description: Modern Filipino culinary artistry combining tradition with contemporary techniques. Showcases local flavors with creative presentation.

name: Italianni's Restaurant
description: Italian cuisine featuring pasta pizza and classic dishes. Family-friendly casual dining with consistent quality across menu.

name: Bigby's Cafe and Restaurant
description: Popular local chain known for comfort food. Signature ribs sandwiches and desserts. Casual relaxed atmosphere.

name: Fat Monk Kitchen Bar
description: Fusion cuisine with creative cocktails. Modern industrial ambiance. Popular spot for dinner and drinks.

name: Ember Grillery
description: Specializes in grilled meats and seafood. Filipino-style barbecue and grilled dishes. Casual dining with smoky flavors.

name: Lighthouse Restaurant
description: Seafood specialist with Filipino preparations. Fresh catch and local recipes. Ocean-inspired ambiance.

name: Missy Bon Bon
description: Charming cafe known for pastries desserts and coffee. Instagram-worthy interior. Perfect for afternoon treats.

name: Jonie's Sizzlers and Roast
description: Famous for sizzling dishes and roasted specialties. Budget-friendly Filipino comfort food. Multiple branches across city.

name: Ribs and Bibs Restaurant
description: American-style barbecue ribs and comfort food. Known for tender meats and hearty portions. Family-friendly casual dining.

name: Yoshimeatsu
description: Yakiniku Japanese BBQ and Korean grill fusion. All-you-can-eat options available. Interactive grilling experience.

name: Tong Yang
description: Asian hotpot and grill buffet. Unlimited meat seafood and vegetables. Popular for group dining and celebrations.

name: P.O.P.S All Filipino Buffet
description: All-Filipino buffet showcasing ???????????? dishes. Every bite tells a story of traditional cuisine. Great value for trying multiple dishes.

name: La Halohalo Divisoria
description: Ultimate destination for traditional Filipino halo-halo and local delicacies. Refreshing desserts and sweet treats. Perfect after meal or during hot day.

name: Jerald Food Hauz
description: Culinary gem showcasing authentic local flavors. Home-style Filipino cooking with generous portions. Friendly hospitality.

name: Starbucks Centrio
description: International coffee chain. Consistent quality coffee pastries and light meals. Comfortable seating and WiFi available.

name: Park Cafe
description: Local cafe near park areas. Coffee light snacks and local beverages. Casual neighborhood spot.

name: Misto Restaurant
description: Hotel restaurant serving international dishes Filipino favorites and regional specialties. Buffet breakfast and ala carte options. Indoor and al fresco dining.
